protocol.name: no_retraining_physical_prior_identifiability_audit
protocol.centered_log_shape: log(rate_clamped) minus its valid-point within-sequence mean
protocol.shape_mse: mean squared difference between learned and physical centered-log rates over points where physics_rate > 0

availability.learned_rate_source: deterministic evaluation-mode forward replay of existing checkpoints

cached_metadata.method: anchored sample_id parsing, cross-checked against each cached DegradationSeries and its parallel dataset.groups entry

interpretation_boundary.scale_invariance: Within-sequence centering removes every positive sequence-level multiplicative rate scale when clamp activation is unchanged.
interpretation_boundary.capacitor: All capacitor prior shapes are constant in time; the loss is a constant-rate-shape regularizer and cannot express cross-voltage damage-rate magnitude.
